title: Homegrown
description: A go-between (Kelly Lynch) helps California marijuana growers (Billy Bob Thornton, Hank Azaria) take action when their boss is killed.

title: Sophie's Choice
description: A Southern writer (Peter MacNicol) lives in Brooklyn with an Auschwitz survivor (Meryl Streep) and her mad lover (Kevin Kline).

title: Marlowe
description: Detective Philip Marlowe becomes embroiled in an investigation with a wealthy family in Bay City, Calif., after a beautiful blonde hires him to find her former lover.

title: Q: The Winged Serpent
description: A fleeing gangland flunky (Michael Moriarty) finds the New York nest of Aztec deity Quetzalcoatl, the man-eating flying serpent.

title: Foreign Correspondent
description: A political assassination plunges an American reporter into international intrigue in pre-World War II Europe.

title: Once Upon a Time in China
description: A man (Jet Li) must protect his martial-arts school while sorting out his feelings for a young woman (Biao Yuen) who is his aunt by adoption.

title: Stay Cool
description: A successful author (Mark Polish) reunites with a high-school beauty (Winona Ryder) when he returns to his hometown.

title: Animal Factory
description: Sentenced to the state penitentiary for dealing drugs, a middle-class young man (Edward Furlong) seeks protection from a savvy inmate (Willem Dafoe).

title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
description: King Arthur (Graham Chapman) goes questing on a pretend horse, followed by his lackey clacking coconut shells.

title: Glengarry Glen Ross
description: Underhanded real estate salesmen sink to varying levels of deceit in order to sell their dubious properties.

title: The Gambler V: Playing for Keeps
description:
S01 E01
Cardsharp Brady Hawkes searches for his son, who is on the run with outlaws Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid.

title: Alligator
description: A herpetologist helps a detective track her flushed-away pet, now a king-size mutant called Ramone.

title: Sisters
description: A small-time reporter tries to convince the police she saw a murder in the apartment across from hers.

title: Donnie Darko: The Director's Cut
description: An unusual teenager (Jake Gyllenhaal) follows the instructions of the 6-foot-tall rabbit which saved his life.

title: Point Break
description: An FBI agent (Keanu Reeves) turns California surfer to nab bank robbers who wear rubber masks of four ex-presidents.

title: Raise the Titanic
description: A U.S. admiral (Jason Robards) and his team (Richard Jordan, David Selby) compete with Russians in an attempt to salvage the luxury liner.

title: The Exorcist III
description: A police detective (George C. Scott) investigates a series of slayings done in the style of an executed killer (Brad Dourif).

title: Deadly Outlaw: Rekka
description: A yakuza (Riki Takeuchi) becomes the target of two clans after the murder of his beloved boss.

title: Lancaster Skies
description: A solitary Spitfire ace pilot must overcome his past to lead a Lancaster bomber crew in the pivotal aerial war over Berlin in 1944.

title: Piranha
description: Two people (Bradford Dillman, Heather Menzies) unwittingly free a mad military scientist's (Kevin McCarthy) mutant fish near a summer camp and resort lake.

title: Crimson Rivers: Angels of the Apocalypse
description: Three investigators (Jean Reno, Benoît Magimel, Camille Natta) track a cloaked killer who possesses superhuman strength and speed.

title: Battle Creek Brawl
description: In the 1930s, an effete Chicago mobster (Jose Ferrer) pits a Chinese kicker (Jackie Chan) against a king-size brute called Kiss.

title: A Better Tomorrow III
description: Cheung meets a beautiful gang-leader while trying to bring his family from wartime Saigon to Hong Kong.

title: Standing Up, Falling Down
description: A failing stand-up comedian and an alcoholic dermatologist give each other the confidence to face the failures in their lives.

title: Villains
description: Amateur criminals stumble upon a dark secret in a sadistic couple's home.

title: Agent Red
description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility.

title: Bright Young Things
description: After losing the manuscript of his first novel, a penniless writer (Stephen Campbell Moore) must raise enough money to marry his superficial girlfriend (Emily Mortimer).

title: The Bodyguard
description: Kiba is back again, but this time he has fallen from grace and been sent to prison for all the violent acts he has committed. Once he's out, he begins working as a bodyguard in a club that is crawling with gangsters.

title: All I See Is You
description: In Bangkok, a young blind woman undergoes a cutting-edge operation that restores sight to her right eye. Able to see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes her husband feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

title: Silver City
description: A campaign manager hires a private detective (Danny Huston) after a Colorado gubernatorial candidate finds a dead body while fishing.

title: City on Fire
description: An undercover cop (Chow Yun-Fat) infiltrates a gang of jewel thieves, but things go terribly wrong during a heist.

title: Capricorn One
description: The first manned flight to Mars is a flop, so a space official (Hal Holbrook) fakes it Hollywood-style for the public.

title: To Kill With Intrigue
description: The Honeybee Flower gang kills everyone in Lei mansion but Siao Lei, spared by their leader because she likes him.

title: Escape to Athena
description: A Greek partisan (Telly Savalas) helps Allied prisoners escape with ancient art from a German major's (Roger Moore) island prison.

title: Candy
description: A fatherly chemistry professor indulges two young lovers in their ever-increasing heroin habits as his life spins out of control.

title: Joe Strummer: The Future Is Unwritten
description: Martin Scorsese, Bono, Jim Jarmusch, Flea and others recall the life of Joe Strummer, singer and guitarist for the Clash.

title: Suburbia
description: An overwhelming sense of despair impels a teenager to leave his suburban home and join up with a group of punk rockers.

title: The Decline of Western Civilization Part III
description: Filmmaker Penelope Spheeris examines the lives of young punk fans who live homeless on the streets of Los Angeles.

title: Sea Fever
description: A marine biology student and other crew members fight for survival when an unfathomable life-form attacks their fishing trawler.

title: Security
description: A mall security guard has to protect a female witness from a gang after they lose all forms of communication during a storm.

title: A Walk to Remember
description: Forced to tutor students at a school, a young delinquent (Shane West) falls for a minister's (Peter Coyote) daughter (Mandy Moore).
